conflicts.name: Ukraine
conflicts.summary: A full-scale interstate war with major international, security, displacement, and infrastructure implications. Public reporting should be compared across independent sources.

conflicts.name: Israel / Gaza
conflicts.summary: Conflict coverage should separate verified events, official statements, humanitarian reporting, and disputed claims. Geographic layers must be generalized and dated.

areas.name: Regional context

conflicts.name: Sudan
conflicts.summary: A complex civil war with severe humanitarian consequences. Attribute claims carefully and distinguish access constraints from absence of events.

conflicts.name: Myanmar
conflicts.summary: A multi-actor conflict with geographically varied dynamics. Public summaries should identify the reporting period and the limitations of available evidence.

conflicts.name: Central Sahel
conflicts.summary: A regional set of armed conflicts. Coverage should avoid collapsing separate national and local dynamics into a single frontline narrative.

reports.title: How to read this conflict map
reports.summary: This entry demonstrates the report format. It is not a current battlefield event or a claim about territorial control.
reports.body: A publishable report should identify the reporting period, cite the original source, explain corroboration, and state what remains unknown. Avoid treating a single social-media post or official statement as independently verified fact.

sources.name: UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs
